population: Retrospective United States statistical population (all residents counted by the historical series); not white-specific, not local, not lineage-based.
measure: Net international migration as a percentage of total national population growth over each interval.

source.title: Michael R. Haines, 'Population characteristics', Historical Statistics of the United States, Millennial Edition, Table Aa15-21: Population, by components of change, 1790-2000
source.read_status: table values transcribed from the publisher's table; component definitions read

limitations: Shares are reported values; the underlying component counts are not reproduced here, so the shares cannot be recomputed from this record.
Historical boundary changes (annexation) alter the counted population.
